verdict.rationale: Employees have a 'My Equity' view in the platform where they can see their available grants and exercise options. It is a real employee-facing grant view, but thinly evidenced. The documented scenario modeling is a company-side tool for modeling future rounds, not an employee equity-value calculator, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented vesting-progress display, strike price shown to employees, employee-facing modeling of equity value under different outcomes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes

citations.quote: click on My Equity to view your available grants. Grants with an Exercise Now button have options available for exercise.
Select the number of shares you want to exercise. Sign the Exercise Documents and secure spousal consent (if applicable).
